chapter.heading: Revelation 13
The First Beast
chapter.v: the whole earth marveled as they followed the beast.
“Who is like the beast, and who can fight against it?”
It opened its mouth to utter blasphemies against God, blaspheming his name and his dwelling, that is, those who dwell in heaven.
to make war on the saints and to conquer them. And authority was given it over every tribe and people and language and nation,
If anyone has an ear, let him hear:
Here is a call for the endurance and faith of the saints.
I saw another beast rising out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon.
making fire come down from heaven to earth in front of people,
that was wounded by the sword and yet lived.
to be marked on the right hand or the forehead,
of a man, and his number is 666.
